review.notes: Full re-review. All nine findings of the review of f4e861f are repaired. One-tactic probe: exists_full_row_minor closes with one exact from Tau Ceti's Matrix.linearIndependent_row_iff_exists_det_submatrix_ne_zero (R01); the other 16 theorems do not close. The 15 seeded targets were verified at their locators in IK, P, M, W and Treil, plus Laurent §6.1. The adversarial table has computed values (exact-arithmetic script): 15 confluent determinants, 6 Gram identities, the Kronecker chain-rule reading (R03) and Lucas congruences for p^e (R02). Citations to CharacterSumsOverFiniteFields, GrothendieckNotesLemmas, DiophantineApproximationAndTranscendence, GenericDoublePointInterpolation and IntegralIwasawaTheory were resolved, and ownership was searched with roadmaps grep.
